decisions.reason: Height-adjustable executive desks fit the firm's office furniture business and the post-pandemic shift in office needs, so the option still holds value and costs little to keep.
A chair family is central to the premium portfolio and can be extended with variants, so keeping this flexible option open is worthwhile.
Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche accessory with uncertain demand, but they reuse rug materials and cost little to keep, so the option stays open for now despite a higher drop risk.
A designer sofa featured prominently in 2019 belongs to the firm's core upholstery strength and typically stays in the range for many years.
A high standing table complements the office and lounge systems at low holding cost, so there is no clear negative signal to justify abandoning it.
The rug collection extends the brand into interior accessories at modest cost, and its value is still unfolding, so it is kept.
